column1: a session that ends is followed by the next after the pause
a session that cannot be made is tried again after the same pause
a GOAWAY has the next session made at once
GOAWAYs in a row: at once once, then after the pause, then at once again
a session that ends or fails after a GOAWAY is followed after the pause, and the next GOAWAY at once
a session longer than the pause is followed at once
